Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
Our cloud segment grew 16% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Revenue guidance of $39.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
Operating income reached $8.3 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 16% to 26% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $39.1 billion this quarter, representing 16% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
